funeral_director_code_of_conduct: Maintain a dignified, respectful, and compassionate demeanor at all times in the presence of families.
Wear clean, professional attire consisting of a dark suit, white collared shirt, and dark tie during all family meetings, wakes, and cortege processions.
Provide complete transparency regarding all package items, pricing, and potential variable costs without pressure or upselling.
Obtain explicit written consent from the family prior to ordering any additional services, logistics, or supplies.
Fully coordinate and confirm all municipal wake permits (HDB Town Council, LTA road notices, SLA TOLs) prior to wake setup.
Arrive at least 30 minutes before the scheduled casket arrival on the first day and cortege departure on the final day.
Verify the identities of deceased and family details carefully against official digital death certificates before any transport or embalming takes place.

daily_wake_duties: Perform a thorough site inspection twice daily to ensure the canvas tent or parlour space is clean, sanitary, and functional.
Keep guest tables and seating areas organized, wiped down, and clear of empty containers or trash.
Regularly replenish refreshments, including packet drinks, snacks, peanuts, and paper cups in the guest service area.
Monitor on-site sanitation facilities, coordinate emptying of waste bins, and keep hand sanitizer stations topped up.
Verify that ambient lighting, fans, air coolers, and sound equipment are working and adjusted appropriately for the weather.
vendor_coordination: Liaise with catering staff to ensure food warmers, buffet setup, and dietary requests are delivered on schedule.
Coordinate floral delivery schedules, ensuring wreaths and portrait frames are styled and positioned correctly.
Confirm the arrival times of religious officiants (monks, priests, pastors, celebrants) and assist them in setting up required ritual items.
Coordinate with transport coordinators, bus drivers, and police/traffic escorts for cortege assembly and departure times.
problem_escalation_protocol: Address minor logistics challenges (e.g., additional tables/chairs needed, minor spills) immediately on-site.
Report electrical or water supply failures from HDB Town Council DB boxes to the operations manager and local town council hotline within 10 minutes of occurrence.
Escalate safety hazards, structural tentage concerns, or vendor delivery delays exceeding 30 minutes to the Operations Director immediately.
Coordinate a formal handoff to the night security team if the family has booked overnight guard services, briefing them on emergency contacts.

transparency_guarantees: 100% Price Transparency Guarantee: The price listed in the package quote is the price you pay, with no hidden administration, processing, or fuel surcharges.
Zero markup on third-party government disbursements: All municipal permits, cremation bookings, and cemetery fees are passed through to the client at cost with original receipts provided.
No verbal commitments: Every agreement for extra services, flowers, or catering must be documented on an interim billing sheet and signed by both the Funeral Butler and the family representative.
Price Match Promise: We promise to match the price of the exact same package from the same provider if found at a lower price elsewhere.
